decisions.reason: The award signal and continued website presence put this yogurt clearly above a reasonable aspiration level for a newly launched dairy product, so management would keep it.
Its prominent home-page launch suggests strategic importance and enough early support to justify keeping it while the firm learns about repeat demand.
With only basic website mention and no strong success signal, this cheese sits in an uncertain zone, but a German food producer would usually allow more time before reallocating resources.
The spicy cheese has no visible performance signal yet, but as a recent line extension it would likely be retained while management observes whether it reaches acceptable sales.
The product appears to broaden the soft-cheese range and therefore likely benefits from portfolio logic and organisational slack, reducing the chance of an early withdrawal.

This washed-rind soft cheese lacks explicit evidence of strong market traction, yet the firm would probably keep it for another period because the information is still too limited for a clear failure judgment.
